name: Routes of Santiago de Compostela: Camino Francés and Routes of Northern Spain
description: This is a web of medieval pilgrim paths across northern Spain, including the busy Camino Francés, the Primitive Way, the Coastal Way and the Interior Way. Together they cover almost 1,500 km, all leading to Santiago de Compostela. Walkers still follow them past cathedrals, churches, hospitals, hostels and bridges built for pilgrims, honouring a tomb believed to be St. James's, discovered in the 9th century.
